statusNote: The 0.24.0 release notes are changing (wording fix, maintainer decision 2026-10-07), so this list is not the section 8 claim registry. The second C2 regeneration, on the re-frozen candidate, commits the registry that section 8 freezes; A1 must not read this file as frozen.
rule: Contract 1.3.2 section 8 Required subjects: at the #1424 raw-artifact freeze, #1424 commits the claim registry (every public or release claim the milestone intends to make); #1408 cannot add, drop, or rename a claim. R2 reads {"claims": ["claim:<id>", ...]} (scripts/verify_release_adjudication.py claim_registry).
scope: The claims the 0.24.0 release makes, taken from the candidate's release surface: the CHANGELOG.md [0.24.0] section (rendered byte-identically as the GitHub release notes candidate and as the website changelog page). Each substantive statement of fact or behavior is one claim; restatements of the same behavior share an id. Pre-0.24 website and changelog content is historical (inventory: changelog historical-only) and is not registered as a 0.24 claim. Drafted by the C2 agent; the maintainer may correct the list before A1 starts, and a change after that is not possible under section 8.

claim:release-adds-no-syntax.text: Calor 0.24 is a soundness release ... It adds no new syntax.

claim:release-history-0.22-0.23.text: First release on NuGet since 0.21.0; 0.22.0 never reached NuGet (publish skipped after performance tests failed); milestone 0.23 shipped no code.

claim:evidence-bounded-not-independent.text: The 0.24 evidence is adjudicated by the maintainer who directed and merged the repairs; not independently adjudicated or verified; every 0.24 evidence claim is at most bounded.
claim:evidence-bounded-not-independent.c2Note: R2's wording scan (G012) flags 'independently verified' on line 12: the negation 'not' does not directly precede the second phrase. See regeneration.md.

claim:no-benchmark-results-published.text: No benchmark results are published with this release.

claim:advisory-7-false-proofs-in-4-areas.text: The sweep found 7 false proofs in 4 areas in each of 0.21.0 (NuGet) and v0.22.0 (source); 3 removed runtime checks, 4 wrong interface acceptances; the published 0.21.0 package is unchanged.

claim:sweep-limits.text: 710 cases per build, macOS arm64, run twice with the same verdicts and findings (one counterexample differed, both violating); 79 of 100 rows found no counterexample, 44 of those contain no proven case; 7 rows not run; whole-compiler soundness not established.

claim:all-34-findings-fixed-or-demoted.text: The other 27 findings per build (8 true proofs of forbidden forms, 17 spurious refutations, 2 stale cache verdicts) plus the 7 false proofs: 0.24.0 fixes or visibly demotes all 34; a demoted form keeps its runtime check.

claim:obligation-stale-facts-demoted.text: Obligations no longer use facts an assignment made stale; the obligation is Unsupported (Calor1124) and the runtime check stays; new facts for else/elseif and named refinement parameters.

claim:cache-literal-width-fixed.text: The verification cache key includes literal width, signedness, and real kind; INT:1 vs LONG:1 is refuted as it should be.

claim:interface-checks-throwing-precondi.text: Interface contract checks model throwing preconditions: null-string cases are Assumed with Calor0819, the remainder case is refuted with Calor0810 (x = 3, y = 0); Calor0816/Calor0814 behavior as described.

claim:non-ascii-solver-symbols-escaped.text: Z3 symbol names for non-ASCII identifiers are escaped to ASCII (#1493); the Windows collision was not observed in practice.

claim:warning-calor0819-added.text: New warning Calor0819 ('Assumed, not proven') for interface contract checks.

claim:reproducible-release-evidence-and-.text: The repository records the evidence contract, the registered sweep and results, a disposition for every finding, and a determinism protocol; a release can be published only through a gate that checks one adjudication record (#1410).

claim:benchmark-publication-refuses-inco.text: The benchmark workflow proposes one headline built only from the B1 packet and fails, opening no PR, on non-EQUIVALENT included pairs, changed pairs, an unamended method change, a differing regenerated packet, or a provenance commit that is not a full SHA on main; allow_weaker_methodology removed.

claim:agent-refactoring-job-no-commit.text: The agent refactoring job no longer commits to main and fails when it cannot read a pass rate.

claim:historical-benchmark-numbers-label.text: Older website benchmark numbers stay published, labeled not comparable under the 0.24 method.

claim:z3-single-verified-path-five-rids.text: Z3 natives reach every consumer through one verified build step; packages carry linux-x64, linux-arm64, osx-arm64, win-x64, win-arm64.

claim:fixture-checks-truthful.text: The fixture script says it compiles each fixture once; explicit expectations for 509 tracked .calr fixtures: 428 compile, 51 must be rejected, 30 known failures never count as passes.

claim:numeric-forms-refused-or-demoted.text: Narrow (<32-bit) arithmetic Unsupported (D1); out-of-range INT: literals Unsupported (D2), including whole-loop k-induction; checked-arithmetic postconditions Assumed unless a fixed operand-width rule shows no overflow (no solver query).

claim:differential-totals-429-156-585.text: In the verifier-runtime differential report, 6 of 1,170 cases move from Proven to Assumed; totals 429 Proven, 156 Assumed, 585 refuted.

claim:text-utf16-code-units.text: String literals reach Z3 as UTF-16 code units; backslash not a Z3 escape; Substring range conditions; IndexOf with a start index Unsupported; null-satisfiable precondition sets are Unsupported, not vacuous.

claim:nested-quantifier-unsupported.text: A quantifier nested in another is not verified (Unsupported, runtime check kept, never cached); a k-induction invariant with an unparseable conjunct is not reported proven.

claim:determinism-causes-fixed.text: Three causes of run-to-run and platform-dependent verdicts are fixed (fresh Z3 context per query, Windows string encoding, USERPROFILE for the user-level cache); whether the verifier is deterministic on every supported platform is decided by the registered determinism protocol (#1421), which runs after this change.
claim:determinism-causes-fixed.c2Note: The candidate-time protocol execution is C2's lane ci-determinism; see ledger.json.

claim:unreachable-counterexamples-withhe.text: Failed obligations are reported as Calor1124 (unsupported, runtime check kept) when something evaluated before may throw or the obligation reads a property; these checks never make an obligation proven or discharged.

claim:empty-clause-body-fixed.text: An empty clause body no longer swallows the next statement (#1485), for every construct with an indented body.

claim:cache-format-1.22.text: The verification cache format is 1.22; older entries are invalidated and recomputed.
